principles.statement: Record an unsupported or minimally supported attempt before showing answer-bearing captions/translation whenever independent listening evidence is the goal.
Treat caption-visible comprehension and independent audio comprehension as distinct evidence states.
Select support by diagnosed bottleneck: replay for another acoustic encounter, L2 text for form/segmentation, and Vietnamese support for meaning.
Replay does not reveal an answer, but every replay increments exposure count and cannot be labeled first-seen evidence.
Do not assume keyword or partial captions are inherently better than full captions; choose mode by task and learner reliance profile.
Use L2 captions when speech-form mapping/segmentation is the target; do not let their presence count as independent form recognition for the same segment.
Use Vietnamese semantic support when meaning is the bottleneck and keep it as bounded as the task allows.
Full L1 subtitles/translation may support content access, but success after full meaning reveal cannot establish independent L2 message comprehension.
Treat a full transcript as an analysis/repair support state rather than default evidence-bearing listening display.
Do not hard-code captions-first or audio-first as a universal scientific rule; test order policies against delayed unsupported listening.
Fade support based on learner evidence on support-reduced and unseen parallel input, not by a fixed week count or CEFR-only threshold.
Track individual caption reliance/support history because proficiency alone does not fully determine the best caption mode.
Increase caution with always-on captions as visual/speaker complexity rises because lower-proficiency learners may shift even more strongly toward text.
Preserve support provenance for every attempt: caption language/mode, transcript visibility, Vietnamese gloss level, replay count, playback rate and exposure index.
Keep exact support ordering, fading thresholds and transcript/replay policies falsifiable until EXP-010 validates them with the target population.
